title: Data for Schema Change in the Wild: a census of state migrations in Urbit, 2013–2026
description:
A classified census of state migrations in the Urbit personal server, reconstructed from public Git history (2013–2026): 111 migration steps in five system components (Ames, Gall, Clay, Dojo, Hood) and 38 migration rows in six userspace agents.

Each step carries a kind, flags, and a sequence of operators drawn from Cambria's lens operators plus five additions, with the labels of two independent LLM coders and the author's adjudication. Includes version-landing histories, network protocol-version changes, the review interface with per-step diffs, and the scripts that generate every table and figure in the accompanying paper, Schema Change in the Wild (Substrates 2027). Data are CC BY 4.0; code is MIT (see LICENSE).
